body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Dion expects to unveil new digital photo frame 'DION' series at upcoming CES 2008 in Las Vegas, USA. The DION series ranges from 3.5-inch to 7-inch and of the series 'SDP-MB' is noticeable with wine-glass-design. The SDP-MB features 7-inch Samsung TFT LCD(800x480), 300:1 contrast ratio, 350cm/m2 brightness, and 128MB internal memory and it is compatible with other kinds including SD,MMC,MS,CF, and xD. It can rotate 90-degree. A company official said that next lineup will support DAB/DMB feature as well.
